functions.name: fn_get_level_master_id
functions.arguments: p_subject_code character varying, p_level_code character varying
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION kumon.fn_get_level_master_id(p_subject_code character varying, p_level_code character varying)
 RETURNS smallint
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
	SELECT lm.level_master_id
	FROM level_master lm
	JOIN subject_master sm
		ON sm.subject_id = lm.subject_id
	WHERE sm.subject_code = p_subject_code
		AND lm.level_code = p_level_code;
$function$

functions.name: fn_get_worksheet_master_id
functions.arguments: p_subject_code character varying, p_level_code character varying, p_worksheet_no integer
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION kumon.fn_get_worksheet_master_id(p_subject_code character varying, p_level_code character varying, p_worksheet_no integer)
 RETURNS smallint
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
	SELECT wm.worksheet_master_id
	FROM worksheet_master wm
	JOIN level_master lm
		ON lm.level_master_id = wm.level_master_id
	JOIN subject_master sm
		ON sm.subject_id = lm.subject_id
	WHERE lm.level_code = p_level_code
		AND sm.subject_code = p_subject_code
		AND wm.worksheet_no = p_worksheet_no;
$function$
